title.en: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Adlay, Municipality of Carrascal, Province of Surigao Del Sur, to Be Known as the Adlay National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a High School in Barangay Adlay, Municipality of Carrascal, Province of Surigao Del Sur, to Be Known as the Adlay National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Barangay Adlay, Thị trấn Carrascal, Tỉnh Surigao Del Sur được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Adlay
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Adlay, เทศบาล Carrascal, จังหวัด Surigao Del Sur ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Adlay
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Barangay Adlay, Kotamadya Carrascal, Provinsi Surigao Del Sur dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Adlay
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Adlay, Perbandaran Carrascal, Wilayah Surigao Del Sur dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Adlay

text.en: There shall be established a high school in Barangay Adlay, Municipality of Carrascal, Province of Surigao del Sur, to be known as the Adlay National High School.
the Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
the amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
